title: SB19 thanks A'TIN for inspiration through 8 years in music industry
summary: Multi-awarded five-member boy group SB19 celebrated their eighth anniversary with A'TIN during the second day of their first-ever One Zone Fest, Sunday at the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.
